invariants.rationale: MetaClient is required for this method's purpose even if implementation is no-op.
Columns to index should be a valid list input to the method.
If columnsToIndex is non-null, its size is non-negative according to List contract.
Parameter type is HoodieTableMetaClient, so it is guaranteed to be an instance.
If the columnsToIndex list is provided, its elements are possibly expected to be non-null strings.
